verdict.rationale: Datalab documents a dedicated structured-extraction endpoint where you provide a JSON schema and Marker fills it with extracted values (docs-3, docs-32). It is reachable from the Python SDK, can reuse checkpoints from earlier /convert calls, returns citations back to source bounding boxes, and can generate candidate schemas from a file. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that extracted output is validated against the supplied schema, and independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction quality.
